places.name: The Treasury (Al-Khazneh)
places.ai_summary: An iconic sandstone structure and the most famous landmark of Petra, carved into the cliffs.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Capture the Treasury’s beauty when sunlight hits the facade.

attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: The Temple of Winged Lions, Petra, Jordan

places.name: The Siq Canyon Walk
places.ai_summary: A narrow gorge leading to Petra, offering a dramatic entrance to the ancient city.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for the walk.

places.place_tip: Look for carvings along the canyon walls.

places.name: Monastery (Ad-Deir)
places.ai_summary: A massive rock-carved structure located at the end of a challenging hike in Petra.

opening_hours.notes: The hike to the Monastery takes about an hour.

places.place_tip: Carry water and take breaks during the hike.

attribution.title: Temple of Winged Lions, Petra 01
attribution.author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution.description: The Temple of Winged Lions, Petra, Jordan

places.name: High Place of Sacrifice
places.ai_summary: An elevated area in Petra offering stunning views and ancient altars.

opening_hours.notes: The site involves a steep walk up.

places.place_tip: Visit early to enjoy the sunrise over Petra.

places.name: Royal Tombs
places.ai_summary: A group of impressive rock-cut tombs in Petra, showcasing ancient funerary architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area to see different tombs.

places.place_tip: Look for the intricate carvings on the tombs.

places.name: Petra Theater
places.ai_summary: An ancient rock-cut theater in Petra, still used for performances today.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for any performances.

places.place_tip: Attend a show for a unique experience.

places.name: Street of Facades
places.ai_summary: A street in Petra lined with impressive rock-cut facades, leading to the Roman-style theater.

opening_hours.notes: Take your time to explore the area.

places.place_tip: Great spot for photography enthusiasts.

places.name: Colonnaded Street
places.ai_summary: A colonnaded street in Petra, showcasing the Roman influence on the city’s architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Look out for the Corinthian columns.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Petra Museum.

places.name: Byzantine Church
places.ai_summary: An ancient church in Petra with well-preserved mosaics, reflecting the city’s diverse history.

opening_hours.notes: The church is small, visit briefly.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the intricate floor mosaics.

places.name: Petra Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum in Petra showcasing the archaeological and historical significance of the site.

opening_hours.notes: A good place to learn about Petra’s history.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Colonnaded Street.

places.name: Little Petra (Siq al-Barid)
places.ai_summary: A smaller archaeological site near Petra, featuring similar rock-cut architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Less crowded than Petra, a peaceful visit.

places.place_tip: Explore the area around Little Petra as well.

places.name: Al-Khubtha Trail Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A viewpoint in Petra offering panoramic views of the archaeological site and surrounding mountains.

opening_hours.notes: The trail to the viewpoint is steep.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear sturdy shoes.

places.name: Tomb of the Roman Soldier
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved tomb in Petra, notable for its Roman-style architecture and carvings.

opening_hours.notes: The tomb is small, visit briefly.

places.place_tip: Observe the details in the stone carvings.

places.name: Wadi Musa Town Walk
places.ai_summary: A walk through the modern town of Wadi Musa, the gateway to Petra, offering local culture and cuisine.

opening_hours.notes: Explore local shops and try traditional food.

places.place_tip: Visit the local market for souvenirs.

places.name: Petra by Night Experience
places.ai_summary: A magical experience in Petra, where the archaeological site is illuminated by candlelight.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is highly recommended.

places.place_tip: Dress warmly and wear comfortable shoes.

places.name: Jabal Haroun (Aaron’s Tomb Hike)
places.ai_summary: A challenging hike to the supposed burial site of Aaron, offering stunning views of Petra.

opening_hours.notes: The hike is steep and rocky.

places.place_tip: Start early to avoid the heat and crowds.

places.name: Obelisk Tomb
places.ai_summary: A unique tomb in Petra shaped like an obelisk, with intricate carvings and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: The tomb is small, visit briefly.

places.place_tip: Examine the carvings for historical insights.

places.name: Garden Temple
places.ai_summary: A temple in Petra surrounded by a garden, offering a serene environment and historical insights.

opening_hours.notes: A peaceful spot for relaxation.

places.place_tip: Bring a book and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: Petra Basin Trail
places.ai_summary: A trail in Petra leading to a basin, offering unique geological features and solitude.

opening_hours.notes: The trail is less frequented by tourists.

places.place_tip: Ideal for those seeking solitude in Petra.

places.name: Petra Gate Sunrise Spot
places.ai_summary: A popular spot in Petra to view the sunrise, offering breathtaking views and photo opportunities.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to secure a good spot.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.
